bibl.title: tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i 'grel bshad tshig don rnam par nges pa nyi ma'i snying po
ཚད་མ་རྣམ་པར་ངེས་པའི་འགྲེལ་བཤད་ཚིག་དོན་རྣམ་པར་ངེས་པ་ཉི་མའི་སྙིང་པོ
tshad ma rnam nges kyi 'grel bshad
tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i 'grel bshad
bibl.author: bo dong ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs sho re pa
bibl.note:
In the colophon, he presents his work as relying on a composition and teaching by Shes rab 'bum (ID:4576). exX062023-02-2315-43-12
The author makes ca. 200 anonymous references to the views of other scholars; only rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786) and Sa skya paṇḍita (ID:3892) are named in the text, which also cites a quatrain from the latter's mKhas pa rnams la 'jug pa'i sgo (see [FZ6N88AU]: 430, n. 77). There is also a reference to "gNyal pa yab sras" and several references to "yab sras" and "yab sras rnams."
The author's views testify to a combination of the respective systems stemming from these two scholars.
